scope: Working offline decision aid, not an app paywall, settlement statement, demand model or forecast.

knownCases: Gross-basis 15% fee /21% VAT: €9.99 → €6.76 and €14.99 → €10.14 before refunds and support.
Zero volume retains €50 fixed costs; €1 support yields €5.76 unit contribution and nine-sale break-even.
Negative contribution and full refunds have no positive break-even count.
Blank values, sub-cent prices, unsafe amounts/volume and unsafe unit margin at zero volume are rejected.
calculationVerification.rounding: Safe integer cents; tax-exclusive amount, fee and proportional net refund rounded per line. Display is nl-NL EUR.

assumptions.feeBase: Unresolved: selectable gross or tax-exclusive scenario, not a verified Ollo settlement base.
assumptions.refundTreatment: Proportional reversal of proceeds after modeled VAT/fee; actual store refund/fee treatment can differ.

limits: No willingness-to-pay, conversion, CAC, renewal, currency conversion or user/revenue data.
Higher displayed contribution at the same assumed volume does not establish which price performs better in the market.
No billing, publication, external account writes, network integration or app-source changes.
sourceLimit: Google tax-exclusive fee example is conditional on developer-remitted VAT; EU Play Billing guidance assigns VAT remittance to Google. These sources alone do not verify Ollo account-specific fee enrollment, transaction class or settlement base.
